content: Tsaurhahu kukwaryirha
Tsaunǝn kun wangya Faara ni nggǝm nǝn, tsahama tsaurha ƙǝla ndǝghǝn,
tǝ ƙǝm tsawama yi nggǝm ndan, ƙǝla nggǝmna Ƙǝrǝsti ƙǝm, fǝr nǝn fadghǝn ka ƙǝm, sataka na sǝdghǝn mbǝnggǝn, sataka yi Faara.
Amma ahur nun a sǝk nda ko laɓar kulafayirha wa, ko tur yanggini, nduwa nagha suna sǝ ahur nun wa, ƙǝsǝr kamngwa tǝ nafiya Faara na chahal wa.
Nǝghǝn kee tǝ laɓara na mbuduhul tǝ palthya yi nuryirha nduwa na iˈikh kamngwa tǝ kun wa. Ameyedghǝn nama narha usa Faara.
A sǝnunsǝ tǝ ndaarha, niifa na a ǝna pateyirha nduwa susuwayirha, nduwa suna, tsau ɗǝ tal tǝ takkwa ɗaharha, mba nda wal langaarha hu kutǝryid Ƙǝrǝsti tǝ yi Faara wa ko ngguchit.
A nggaɓa niifa kun tǝ laɓarya mere wa. Ƙǝsǝr tur ǝnggini ya ndǝna sǝɓang hur Faara ɗǝ aten nafiya ǝnawa taara tǝ ˈya ndanǝn.
Tsaunǝn kee a wumɗun teena tǝ kanda wa.
Ƙǝsǝr kun kaar nuwun hu wula, amma nanǝnya, wal ɗun kukwaryirha a fad Chinǝm. Nanǝn kee, tsawama nafiya na hu kukwaryirha,
Ƙǝsǝr kukwaryirha na ahur nun ndǝna ɓang ˈya ɓa na ngga, tǝ tsawud nggayirha tǝ ƙǝkafek.
Tsahama ǝngya na a mbǝnanggǝn Chinǝm.
Ndǝghama hai tǝ ǝn wula mbuwa ngga, a meyedghǝn pǝramadghǝn.
Ƙǝsǝr ǝn shilee ni a pǝr ǝnggina nǝm na nda a ǝnaarha ɓǝɓee.
A ɓa ǝnggini a mbǝd kukwaryirha ɓa, kowunni nǝn naghǝn.
Ƙǝsǝr kukwaryirha ndǝn kyangga ˈya pǝpal ɓa. Ndǝghǝnni nda nanda,
Nanǝn kee, kwarama tǝ tsawud nun. A tsauɗun ƙǝla nurya wa, amma tsawama ƙǝla nafiya na ndǝndǝl.
Ənama taara tǝ kwamana wal nun yi nggayirha, ƙǝsǝr ɓenggini nanǝm sǝ yi mbǝlfeerha.
Tsaunǝn kee a naɗun nurya wa, ƙǝl sǝn ˈya nun na mid Chinǝm.
A nggal ɗun tǝ aam inabi wa, yanɗi na ɗang kun hu ǝn shilee ɗǝ wa. Ameyedghǝn lǝgɗaama tǝ Sǝsǝna tǝ Peɗǝnda,
kalaman ndan sǝ tǝ laɓarya yi Dzabura, tǝ amshiya yi faala, tǝ amshiya yi sǝsǝna. Aama amshe a Chinǝm tǝ hur nun heu.
Ƙǝtsar nama narha usa Faara China ǝnagha ǝngya heu, ahu thlǝm Chinǝm Yeeso Ƙǝrǝsti.
Tsawud nishya tǝ hǝshya hu kakhrha
Fǝraman altennun ndan hu Ƙǝrǝsti.
Nishya na tǝ kakhrha teena fǝraman fannun a chimayinun ƙǝla nun ǝnanggǝn Chinǝm.
Ƙǝsǝr chimarha ndǝghǝn ni aten nukkun, ƙǝla na Ƙǝrǝsti aten Ƙǝn hwan Faara, Ndǝghǝnggi tafadghǝn ndǝghǝnni tǝ hǝrǝkrha fadɗi.
Ƙǝla fǝrna fatakkwaya alten ndan a Ƙǝrǝsti, nishya ƙǝm fǝrama alten nun a chimayi nun ko hu mani.
Kun hǝshya nggǝmama nishyinun ƙǝla nggǝmna Ƙǝrǝsti fatakkwayighǝn har fǝr nǝn yiɓǝdghǝn ka kanda
ka a nagha chahal, tsaɓanggǝn ɗǝ tǝ aama tǝ sǝsǝmnda laɓarghǝn.
Əna nǝn kee fǝr nǝn altenggǝn a walgha fatakkwaya mamnggirha na chahal kula ǝn ˈyaara fa nduwa ǝn tsanda nduwa ˈya ɗimi.
Nǝghǝn kee kamɗǝ, hǝshya a nggǝm nishyindan nda ƙǝla nggǝm nanda fad ndan. Ƙǝsǝr kala niifa nggǝmngga nukkun, nggǝm nǝn altenggǝn.
Mbǝ niifa sǝ ˈwagha kar fadghǝn wa, amma nǝn narha hǝɓang nda ƙǝlaghǝn nǝn ha ngga, kǝla na Ƙǝrǝsti laf fatakkwayighǝn,
ƙǝsǝr kǝm ndan ni hu fadghǝn.
Kǝla ndana Ɗeleewar Faara,

content.text: kanda kyab tsawanda thlu farha tǝtal.”

content: Ən ɗiya nǝghǝn ɓǝɓee kuɗimnggǝn kaan, amma niyi a ndaarha Ƙǝrǝsti ni tǝ fatakkwaya.
Nanǝn kee, kala hǝshnefa tǝtani a nggǝm nukkun nǝn ƙǝla nggǝm nǝn altenggǝn, kala nuneefa ƙǝm tǝta ni a fǝrang mamnggirha nǝn chimadghǝn.
